extra.reason: init results ([:ok s], [:ok s action], [:stop r], [:error r], :ignore) for gen_server and gen_statem, and every callback's action (timeout, :hibernate, [:continue c]) with handle-continue, specced in callback_spec and statem_spec (all laws proved). Not expressible in writ: that a continue runs before the next message is taken (an order of effects in the loop); covered by behaviour tests.

ignore from a child start (spec kept with no process, not for temporary or simple_one_for_one), start_child answers {ok, undefined}, restart/delete/terminate guards incl. restarting, which_children undefined/restarting: childspec_spec, 41/41 proved, supervisor wired through after-start/start-reply/may/shown.

Done with .1: [:continue c] from init and every callback, handle-continue before the next message, a continue may continue or stop. The interpretation is proved in callback_spec; that no message is taken first is an effect order writ cannot state, so gen_server_test covers it.

act/hibernate! (erlang:hibernate/3) through a life machine (life_spec, all transitions checked); gen_server :hibernate action and :hibernate-after; gen_statem :hibernate action (statem_spec) with a wake timer for pending timeouts. Two shell races found by stress tests, not by writ: a kill before a new fiber's masked section, and a spurious wake from a late ring.

ensemble.timer (send-after, start-timer, cancel/read-timer with async/info/abs; timer module's apply-after, send/apply-interval, exit/kill-after, cancel) over the pure table ensemble.timers: timers_spec 21/21 proved with two lemmas in timers_proof. Needed writ: sort-by, mapv/filterv/not-any?/reduce, typed vector params for conj, and a soundness fix for filter equality.

send-request / check / wait / receive-response and request id collections over ensemble.request: request_spec 13/13. Collections are vectors, since writ cannot iterate a map; the reply step needed graph :witnesses (a new writ option), as no generated message carries its request's alias.
